question: In which ritual and experiential contexts is Caṇḍikā said to be active?
premises: The teaching refers to a fourteenfold range of contexts.
These include being, flower, incense, food offering, lamp, recitation, and fire offering.
Caṇḍikā is present and active in all these contexts.
inference: Caṇḍikā pervades and enacts the ritual across all the listed domains.
uncertainties: The full content of the fourteenfold classification is not enumerated in this verse.
plain_english: In the fourteenfold range—in being, in flower, incense, food offering, lamp, recitation, and likewise in fire offering—Caṇḍikā is present everywhere.
